$comment: C17.1 C — SOURCE-OFFER RECORDS for components whose licence requires offering the
C17 emitted an obligation line saying source 'must be offered' and offered nothing. That is a
promise, not a deliverable, and a gate reporting zero unresolved obligations while required
material remains merely promised is reporting the wrong thing.
Each record names the exact component, the exact upstream repository and tag the binary was
built from, and a concrete route by which a recipient obtains that source. The values are
taken from the package's OWN manifest (repository, version, author) — not invented — and the
gate checks each record against the materialized package before accepting it.
A component that requires a source offer and has no record here is an unresolved obligation

records.name: @img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64
why: This package ships a PREBUILT libvips shared library for linux-x64. libvips is licensed
LGPL-2.1-or-later and this distribution is declared LGPL-3.0-or-later, so a recipient of
the binary is entitled to the corresponding source of the licensed library, and to relink
the work against a modified version of it.

corresponding_source.author: Lovell Fuller <npm@lovell.info>
obtain: The complete build recipe for this exact artifact is the sharp-libvips repository at tag
v1.3.2, directory npm/linux-x64, which pins the libvips version and every bundled
git clone https://github.com/lovell/sharp-libvips && cd sharp-libvips && git checkout v1.3.2
The libvips sources themselves are at https://github.com/libvips/libvips at the tag that
relinking: The library is a standalone shared object under lib/ in the installed package, so a
recipient may replace it with a compatible build of libvips without rebuilding sharp.

records.modification_statement: This project distributes the binary UNMODIFIED, exactly as published on the npm registry at the version the lockfile pins. No changes have been made to libvips or to this package.
limits: This record states where the corresponding source is and that the artifact is unmodified.
It is not legal advice and does not assert that any particular distribution scenario is
compliant. Phase 0 is a LOCAL-ONLY profile under EXC-P0-004 and distributes nothing.

records.name: lightningcss
why: MPL-2.0 requires that the source of any MODIFIED licensed file be made available to
recipients. It is a per-file obligation, not a whole-work one.

obtain: git clone https://github.com/parcel-bundler/lightningcss && cd lightningcss && git checkout v1.33.0

records.modification_statement: This project distributes the package UNMODIFIED at the version the lockfile pins, so no MPL-2.0 file has been modified and the per-file source obligation is satisfied by the upstream repository above.
limits: Not legal advice. Phase 0 distributes nothing.

records.name: lightningcss-linux-x64-gnu
why: The prebuilt linux-x64 native binding for lightningcss, under the same MPL-2.0 per-file
source obligation as the package that loads it.

obtain: git clone https://github.com/parcel-bundler/lightningcss && cd lightningcss && git checkout v1.33.0
The napi build for linux-x64-gnu is produced from that tree.
